Exoskeletal_Octopod_Frame.description: The Exoskeletal_Octopod_Frame pulses with otherworldly vitality, its chitin exoskeleton glistening like iridescent armor under moonlight, while eight spindly legs wrap around the terrain with eerie precision. This beast's tremor sense quivers through its frame, guiding it with an innate understanding of the earth beneath its feet.
